title: Lesson 2: The Von Neumann Architecture & the ISA — js-tools
desc: The Von Neumann model (one shared bus for instructions and data) against Harvard (separate buses), the Fetch-Decode-Execute cycle, and the Toy CPU's own 8-instruction ISA before comparing RISC with CISC. Every number verified by running a hand-written Toy CPU: the straight-line 5+3 program takes exactly 5 cycles and writes RAM[10]=8; the BEQ/JMP loop sums 1+2+3+4+5=15 in exactly 26 cycles; the self-modifying-code pitfall genuinely crashes rather than being argued for. Demo: an interactive Toy CPU you can single-step.
descPlain: The Von Neumann model (one shared bus for instructions and data) against Harvard (separate buses), the Fetch-Decode-Execute cycle, and the Toy CPU's own 8-instruction ISA before comparing RISC with CISC. Verified by running real code: the straight-line 5+3 program takes exactly 5 cycles, the BEQ/JMP loop sums 1..5=15 in exactly 26 cycles, and the self-modifying-code pitfall genuinely crashes. Demo: an interactive Toy CPU you can single-step.
